Sheng Zhao · weight-space measurements · dated biographies 2000–2024

Specialist & Generalist Basins

A trained model is one point in weight space. Take three trained models O, A and B, cut the flat plane through them, θ(a, b) = O + a·(A − O) + b·(B − O), and test the model at each of 25 × 25 grid points; (0, 0), (1, 0) and (0, 1) are the trained models.

The specialists of a year learn that year's knowledge well (accuracy ≥ τ); generalists lie where the specialists of different years overlap.
